notes.title: Tactics System, Turn Reset System, and more! (0.2.58)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZK8Y3rZW/0-2-51-Banner-Discord.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Thank you everyone for playing our demo!
Right now, we’re excited to bring you the latest update to Guardian Tactics: Deck of the Chosen. 
Here are the details of what’s new, improved, and fixed in this patch:

[h2]1.Tactics System[/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SxnyPWqN/0-2-54-Tactics.gif[/img]
Players can now select "Tactics" that will offer various benefits playstyles before starting a battle, and again after cleared 4th enemy wave. 
There are total of 8 Tactics that player can choose from.
The effect of Tactics will only be applied to current run.

[h2]2.Turn Reset[/h2]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGRz6qvC/0-2-54-Reset-Turn.gif[/img]
Players can now reset current turn by pressing a reset button at the top-right of the screen.
It has total of 5 reset charges per wave.

[h2]Important Notes:[/h2]
- Many UX/UI Improvements such as indicators and bars that indicates status of Guardian and enemies.
- Adjust Monster Wave
- Some secret behind those monsters! ːsteammockingː

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. 
We hope you enjoy the latest updates and improvements.
[h3]Let's take back the world from the lethal Android![/h3]

[h2]Join our Discord Channel for a closer updates with us![/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/nWFEPzndne][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44925950/62c3206fad749be99b6f1685d9e30695cdad9d31.png[/img][/url]

Hope you have a great day! :)
Urnique Studio Team.
